**Order filled: bought 25 shares of AMZN at $195.50 (≈$4,887.50).**

**Summary:** I read Amazon's fiscal 2023 Form 10-K (filed 2024-02-02) and found a clear fundamental improvement story: total net sales of **$574,785M** (up ~11.8% from $513,983M in 2022), operating income of **$36,852M** (nearly triple the prior year's $12,248M), net income of **$30,425M** versus a **–$2,722M** loss in 2022, diluted EPS of **$2.90** (from –$0.27), and operating cash flow of **$84,946M** — a business that has re-accelerated growth while sharply expanding margins and cash generation. With the quote at $195.25 (bid $195.23 / ask $195.27), I placed a single buy limit order for 25 shares at $195.50, which is within ~0.13% of the market price and filled immediately. The order size of ~$4,888 respects the $5,000 per-order cap and, being the only trade today, stays well inside the $10,000 daily limit; it is a buy in an allowed name (AMZN), and no funds were moved out of the account (cash was $75,000, and the existing 50 HD shares were left untouched).
